title: Striker Right Flank — 8s Cinematic Short

shots.label: Wide tracking - low angle
shots.camera: low-angle tracking from right sideline, wide framing
shots.motion: track with striker, moderate motion blur on legs
shots.base_prompt: Cinematic broadcast-style football match, photorealistic 4K ultra-high detail. A striker in a vibrant red-and-white jersey sprints down the right flank of a perfectly manicured green pitch under bright stadium floodlights.
shots.prompt_modifier: wide composition, emphasize field breadth and crowd, low-angle tracking camera, motion blur

shots.label: Medium close tracking
shots.motion: camera tracks at player speed, slight handheld shake
shots.base_prompt: Cinematic broadcast-style football match, photorealistic. A striker in a red-and-white jersey sprints down the right flank.
shots.prompt_modifier: medium close, low-angle, rim lighting on jersey, motion blur on ball

shots.label: Over-the-shoulder cut inside
shots.camera: over-the-shoulder toward goal, focusing on direction change
shots.motion: subtle dolly and slow 10% speed ramp
shots.base_prompt: Cinematic sports cinematography, striker cutting inside towards goal, dynamic ball trajectory
shots.prompt_modifier: over-the-shoulder, player cutting inside, curved ball trajectory emphasized

shots.label: Close-up on strike
shots.camera: tight close-up on boot and ball at impact
shots.motion: fast shutter effect; crisp contact frame with micro-spark/dust
shots.base_prompt: Extreme close-up on boot striking ball with micro-details, high shutter clarity
shots.prompt_modifier: extreme close-up, high shutter clarity on contact, micro detail on boot and ball

shots.label: Follow-through long shot
shots.camera: long follow arc as ball curves toward goal
shots.motion: smooth tracking on ball arc, crowd reaction blur in background
shots.base_prompt: Long follow shot showing ball curve toward goal with crowd bokeh
shots.prompt_modifier: long follow shot, ball curve emphasized, top-corner trajectory, crowd bokeh

shots.label: Goal frame and freeze
shots.camera: impact-frame at goal, slight slow-mo or freeze-frame
shots.motion: 10% slow or brief freeze, crowd roar audio swell
shots.base_prompt: Goal-frame, high drama, freeze or slow-motion, scoreboard overlay optional
shots.prompt_modifier: goal-frame, high drama, freeze or slow-motion, scoreboard overlay optional

composition_instructions.assemble: Concatenate shots in order, match audio track to shot timestamps, apply 10% speed ramps where noted, apply filmic LUT and color grade

voiceover_lines.text: Here he comes down the right — lightning fast!
He cuts inside — a thunderous strike!
It’s curling — heading for the top corner!

audio.ambience: stadium crowd loop, add whoosh SFX on impact and ball flight, mix at -6 to -10 dB under voice

notes: Adjust seeds per-shot for variation. For wet pitch variation, add 'wet reflections' and 'raindrops' to each shot prompt_modifier. For golden hour, add 'warm sun shafts' and 'golden rim light'.
